text:
The policy I have doesn't say whether a replacement for a lost package ships Express, so I can't promise that. I also can't say whether an upgrade would be free or paid for a replacement.

- **Express in general:** It costs $14.95 and is never free. It's available in Zones 1 and 2 only (next business day in Zone 1, 2 business days in Zone 2). It isn't available in Zone 3, which covers addresses over 1,000 miles from our nearest greenhouse, plus remote and island addresses.
- **XL plants:** These ship Standard only.
- **Shipping days:** Live plants ship Monday to Wednesday only, so a replacement would go out on one of those days.
- **Standard transit:** 2-3 business days in Zone 1, 3-5 in Zone 2 and 5-8 in Zone 3.

I can escalate the Express question to a Support Lead, who can confirm what's possible for your replacement.

One correction to my last message: the refund timings and store credit details I gave aren't in the policy information I have now, so please don't rely on them. A Support Lead can confirm those too if you change your mind.

To start the courier investigation, please send your order number (LF- followed by six digits). Please don't send any card details. Would you like me to escalate the Express question as well?
